gaps.lead: That's the school where my mother teaches.
gaps.explanation: where = in which in formal relative clauses.

gaps.lead: Somebody is repairing our roof at the moment.
gaps.explanation: Somebody else is doing it for us: we are having our roof repaired.

gaps.lead: If I were in charge, overtime would be paid automatically.
gaps.explanation: Dropping 'if' inverts the subjunctive: Were I in charge…

gaps.lead: He no longer thinks he can find a job before the end of the year.
gaps.sentence: He has given ___ a job before the end of the year.
gaps.explanation: 'No longer thinks he can find' becomes 'has given up hope of finding'.

gaps.lead: She started working here five years ago.
gaps.explanation: 'Started five years ago' → present perfect with 'for'.

gaps.lead: 'Don't touch the paintings in this room,' the guide warned us.
gaps.sentence: The guide warned ___ the paintings in that room.
gaps.explanation: Negative commands are reported with warned + object + not to + infinitive.
